name: DogeOS
author: DogeGo
description: Integrate the DogeOS EVM application layer with DogeGo: Chikyū testnet RPC, live metrics, MetaMask/Hardhat/Foundry helpers, faucet/explorer links, and a public HTTP API. Does not change Dogecoin L1 consensus.

rpc.name: info
rpc.help: Network status, metrics summary, and UI workspace.

rpc.name: probe
rpc.help: Probe eth_chainId / eth_blockNumber / eth_gasPrice on the active RPC.

rpc.name: networks
rpc.help: Built-in DogeOS profiles (Chikyū testnet + mainnet placeholder).

rpc.name: helpers
rpc.help: MetaMask, Hardhat, Foundry, ethers, viem, curl, cast snippets.

rpc.name: getbalance
rpc.help: eth_getBalance for an EVM address (wei + DOGE).

rpc.name: getcode
rpc.help: eth_getCode; reports whether address is a contract.

rpc.name: getconfig
rpc.help: Read persisted network / RPC / poll settings.
